Anya (PM): Heads-up — competitor X just announced a $0.02/1k-token "lite" endpoint that bundles reranking. We need a quick call: do we produce a trimmed, lower-cost 'delta' tier (feature-tiling) or match their bundle and absorb margin? Need decision by EOD.
Mike (Eng): Is the competitor hardware optimized or just a bundle? Any perf/tradeoffs noted?
Jordan (Prod Strategy): Their doc shows a smaller context window (6k) and no per-route SLOs. Reranking is on by default but seems single-threaded. Pricing seems targeted at volume marketplaces.
Lee (Sales): Customers are asking for a cheaper option — especially start-ups. If we don't offer something similar, we lose low-touch signup. But Enterprise won't care.
Sam (Design): Important to keep the UX simple for lite users — single API param. If we tile features, we should avoid exposing complexity in SDK.
deploy-bot: [notice] market-monitoring: competitor-x-lite announced (link)
Anya (PM): Proposal A: "Delta Tier" — capped features: no reranking, 6k context, quantized 8-bit default, no per-tenant routing. Price target $0.025/1k. Keeps core Console and rollout tools but disables canaries.
Anya (PM): Proposal B: "Match Bundle" — keep reranking, 12k context, full routing, price $0.035/1k. Higher margin hit but easier sales pitch.
Mike (Eng): Engineering notes: building a separate tier is ~3 sprints to isolate autoscale and cache policies. Removing reranking reduces CPU and memory pressure by ~30%. Matching the bundle requires optimized rerank kernel work — another 1-2 sprints.
Jordan (Prod Strategy): Risk: Proposal B blurs our premium differentiation (SLOs, routing, per-tenant isolation). Proposal A risks losing feature parity ask from some customers.
Lee (Sales): From field: 60% of inbound SMBs will pick price over parity. Enterprise pilots rarely care about price at that level.
Sam (Design): For Proposal A we should provide a discoverability path: clear upgrade CTAs, brief feature comparison in Console. Avoid long docs.
Anya (PM): Quick spec sketch for Proposal A (to share with Eng):
```
- tier_name: "Delta"
- context_window: 6k
- features_disabled: [reranking, per-tenant routing, long-term KV cache]
- quantization: 8-bit default
- streaming: enabled
- rollout_policy: immediate (no canary)
- SLA: best-effort / no latency SLO
- price_target: "$0.025/1k"
```
Mike (Eng): That spec is buildable. We'll need an autoscale policy change + a flag to opt-out of rerank at runtime. Suggest a compatibility shim so existing apps don't break.
Jordan (Prod Strategy): Metrics to monitor if we ship Delta: new signups conversion, upgrade rate to Standard, average tokens per user, error rate delta, latency percentiles. Need dashboard.
Lee (Sales): Can we do an intro promo (first 30 days $0.01/1k) to attract volume? Also ask legal on how competitor wording might trigger responses.
Sam (Design): Console copy suggestion: short bulleted CTA — "Lower price for high-volume experimental apps — upgrade anytime for SLOs and routing." Keep link to full comparison modal.
Anya (PM): Decision proposal: ship Proposal A (Delta) as a time-boxed experiment for 90 days, instrumented for the metrics Jordan listed. If upgrade rate > 8% and churn < 5% -> iterate on parity features.
Mike (Eng): Confirming estimate: 3 sprints (core infra), 1 sprint (compat shim + SDK). Can land a beta behind flag in ~9 weeks.
Jordan (Prod Strategy): I'll own the success metrics and dashboard.
Lee (Sales): I'll prep a one-pager and pitch script for SMBs.
Sam (Design): I'll mock the Console flow and the comparison modal — handoff by next Wed.
Anya (PM): Final ask: Approve experiment? Reply with :+1: to ship Delta, :thinking_face: to request more analysis, or :-1: to match bundle (Proposal B).
Mike (Eng): :+1:
Jordan (Prod Strategy): :+1:
Lee (Sales): :+1:
Sam (Design): :+1:
Anya (PM): Great — moving forward. I'll create the RFC and tracking dashboard. Thanks all.
